basic_details.job_title: TSU Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tribhuvan Sahkari University (TSU) has invited applications for one Senior Consultant (General Administration Department-GAD) post on a contractual basis for a tenure of 11 months, with consolidated pay of Rs.88,000/- per month (all inclusive). Candidates aged 45 to 63 years with a Bachelor's Degree with minimum 60% marks and at least 10 years of experience in a General Administration Department can apply online at tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php until 23:59 hrs on 22 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 45 to 63 years of age. The notice does not print an age relaxation or a date for counting age.

how_to_apply: Only online applications submitted through the official University website portal, https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php, will be accepted. The portal remains open up to 23:59 hrs on 22 November 2026. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form.
Original certificates for educational qualifications, experience, category and age proof, to be produced at document verification/interview.

No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the employer, for applicants currently serving in Government, Autonomous Bodies or PSUs, to be produced at document verification.
important_instructions: No correspondence or queries will be entertained about e-mail delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or reasons for not being called for interview. The University's decision in all selection matters is final. Legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts in Gujarat (Anand/Ahmedabad). Official inquiries about the recruitment drive may be sent by email to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: TSU Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: 11 months, which may be extended based on satisfactory performance and institutional requirements
Selected consultants may be placed at any campus of Tribhuvan Sahkari University

content_sections.heading: About TSU
content_sections.text: According to the notice, Tribhuvan Sahkari University was established through an Act of Parliament in 2025 as an Institution of National Importance. It is dedicated to technical education, management education, training, research and capacity building in the cooperative sector. The notice is signed by the Registrar, TSU, Anand.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is a contractual engagement. Candidates must be citizens of India. Eligibility regarding qualifications and experience is determined as of the closing date for online applications. Essential: minimum 10 years of experience in General Administration Department of a Central Govt./State Government/Autonomous/PSU organizations. Essential: thorough knowledge of the Central Universities Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, Government of India rules and CCS Rules. Essential: excellent administrative, organisational, drafting and communication skills. Essential: working knowledge of computers and relevant software, and proficiency in MS Office, e-Office systems and digital document management. Desirable: handling statutory compliance matters, including processing Right to Information (RTI) Act cases and drafting replies to RTI queries. Preference will be given to retired Sr. Officer/Officer (GAD) (equivalent or higher-level posts) of Central Govt./State Govt./Autonomous/PSU/Statutory Bodies with the above essential experience and professional competence. The age limit is 45 to 63 years of age. The notice does not print an age relaxation or a date for counting age.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent
rows.desirable: Postgraduate degree or professional qualification in Public Administration or related discipline (preference)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay is Rs.88,000/- per month (all inclusive). The tenure is 11 months and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and institutional requirements. The employment type is contractual. Engagement is subject to producing a medical fitness certificate issued by a designated Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TSU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications submitted through the official University website portal, https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php , will be accepted. The portal remains open up to 23:59 hrs on 22 November 2026. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form. Documents named in the notice: Original certificates for educational qualifications, experience, category and age proof, to be produced at document verification/interview. No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the employer, for applicants currently serving in Government, Autonomous Bodies or PSUs, to be produced at document verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting may involve a screening test, followed by a physical interview. Fulfilling the minimum qualifications and experience does not vest any right in a candidate to be shortlisted, and the University's decision to call candidates for interview is final. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the test or interview. Dates and venue of the test or interview are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No correspondence or queries will be entertained about e-mail delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or reasons for not being called for interview. The University's decision in all selection matters is final. Legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts in Gujarat (Anand/Ahmedabad). Official inquiries about the recruitment drive may be sent by email to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Consultant posts has TSU announced?
faq.answer: Tribhuvan Sahkari University has announced 1 post of Senior Consultant (General Administration Department-GAD).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TSU Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The online portal remains open up to 23:59 hrs on 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for TSU Senior Consultant (GAD)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent, plus a minimum of 10 years of experience in a General Administration Department of a Central Govt./State Government/Autonomous/PSU organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TSU Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 to 63 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of TSU Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.88,000/- per month (all inclusive).

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for TSU Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: Apply only online through the official University website portal, https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php. Other modes of application are not mentioned in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisting may involve a screening test, followed by a physical interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

faq.question: Q8. Is the TSU Senior Consultant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the employment type is contractual, for a tenure of 11 months. The tenure may be extended based on satisfactory performance and institutional requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets preference for this post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to retired Sr. Officer/Officer (GAD) of Central Govt./State Govt./Autonomous/PSU/Statutory Bodies who have the essential experience and professional competence.

faq.question: Q10. Do serving government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants currently serving in Government, Autonomous Bodies or PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate from their employer at the time of document verification.
